text.en: Clients speak warmly of the salon's staff and groomers, specifically praising Kelly for her gentle and patient approach with nervous pets. Owners appreciate that team members take time to provide practical brushing tips for home coat maintenance. Reviewers feel confident entrusting both small dogs and giant breeds to the team's professional care.

Pet owners emphasize that dogs feel safe and relaxed during grooming and daycare visits. Reviewers with anxious rescues or large breeds report that their dogs are eager to enter the shop rather than showing fear. Clients value the attentive supervision and gentle treatment given to pets of all sizes throughout their stay.

Clients praise the welcoming atmosphere and convenient Fishtown location for both grooming appointments and overnight boarding services. However, one prospective customer was disappointed to discover by telephone that the facility caters exclusively to dogs and does not offer feline nail trims or grooming care.

q.en: Does Groom & Board offer cat grooming?

a.en: No, reviews indicate that the facility focuses exclusively on canine grooming and does not accept cats.

q.en: Can anxious or sensitive dogs be groomed here?

a.en: Yes, clients report that groomers work patiently with nervous and sensitive dogs to make them comfortable.

q.en: Does the facility provide boarding and daycare?

a.en: Yes, clients mention booking their dogs for both daytime play and overnight boarding.

q.en: Are updates provided while pets are boarded?

a.en: Reviewers note that the team answers questions and shares status updates during boarding stays.
